card.name: Partway through long medical terms
card.fires_on: The word piece in the middle of a long medical term, just before its ending (sequel|ae, ne|op|lasia, hepat|otoxic|ity). Also some nouns after an adjective that the label text then continues, such as 'clinical' or 'effect'.

modes.label: Inside split medical words
modes.description: Middle piece of a rare clinical term that is spelled out in several parts.

modes.label: Noun after modifier
modes.description: A word like clinical, agent or effect in a drug-label phrase, where the sentence goes on.
modes.example: each<< agent>> independently exerted its own blood pressure lowering
